user.title: Set up Heating Analysis
user.description: Map the required sources. The analysis only reads; it never controls anything. Power, heat and outdoor temperature must use a matching unit.

data_description.power_entity: Metered mains power of the heat pump, preferably 1KOMMA5GRAD or a local meter.
data_description.heat_entity: Generated heating energy without domestic hot water, if available.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Outdoor temperature at the system location.
data_description.compressor_entity: Sensor or binary sensor that reports compressor operation.

reconfigure.title: Change required sources
reconfigure.description: Required sources only. Optional sources, heating circuits and rooms are in the options dialog.

error.wrong_unit: The unit does not match this source.
error.wrong_domain: The entity type does not match this source.

abort.already_configured: Heating Analysis is already set up.

sources.title: Optional sources
sources.description: All optional. Empty fields stay unused; the affected metrics become 'unknown'.

data_description.type: Buffer, radiators, underfloor heating or hot water. The assignment comes from the user, never from entity names.

data_description.climate_entity: Optional. Without a thermostat the room is tracked without control and triggers no comfort findings.
data_description.valve_position_entity: Optional. Livisi thermostats do not report a valve position.

error.wrong_unit: The unit does not match this source.
error.wrong_domain: The entity type does not match this source.
error.unknown_circuit: The heating circuit does not exist.
error.circuit_in_use: The heating circuit is still assigned to rooms. Remove those rooms first.
